newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian Adria Air 9 mth passenger traffic up.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian Adria Air 9 mth passenger traffic up.

text.p: Slovenia's Adria Airways carried 473,000 passengers in the first nine months of 1996, up 11 percent on the same period of 1995, the state-owned airline said on Wednesday.
In September alone, Adria carried 64,071 passengers, a 14 percent increase on September last year.
"The number of passengers was up mainly on account of an increase in tourist traffic but we also registered a larger number of business travellers," Adria spokeswoman Ljerka Zupancic told Reuters.
The ariline's cargo traffic over the first nine months was steady at 3,000 tons, while in September cargo traffic rose 16 percent to 353 tons. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
